style: Say in a friendly, youthful way, like a helpful older student
lines: Every gadget takes things in, thinks, and gives things out. Let's look inside!
Tap a part to see which way the dots go. Blue dots go in. Orange dots come out.
Now press the big gold button to run the whole job.
Tap a gadget picture to try another one.
Let's cover a part with a sticky note and see what happens.
Tap Sticky note, then tap a part.
Who can't tell now, the gadget or us? Tap The gadget can't tell, or We can't tell. Then press the big gold button.
Tap Sticky note to cover a new part, or Peel off to take it away.
Touchscreen. It's an input and an output!
